summary: Iteration 19 (Brute-force login protection + Email OTP registration) tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytests pass (4 login_security + 8 new otp_and_security). Frontend: OTP e2e verified (signup -> otp-form -> wrong code shows otp-error -> correct code activates + credits 1000 welcome bonus + lands in app). SUPER_ADMIN Console SecurityPanel renders with empty state after alerts cleared; RBAC 403 for admin1 confirmed. Seeded logins (super/zonal/manager/admin/player) all return 200. No runtime errors on /auth or /console.
critical_code_review_comments: login_security._raise_alert stores per-email lockouts on the shared pod IP (behind ingress) — per-IP counter is essentially global for this deployment; acceptable per current design but worth flagging (comment already notes it).
otp_service logs OTP_DEBUG codes to backend logs when OTP_DEBUG_LOG=true — ensure this flag is disabled in production before launch (currently on).

auth.login uses payload.email (raw case) for user lookup but lowercases 'email' for rate-limiting; if a user signs up in mixed case, lookup may miss while rate-limit fires — recommend normalizing lookup to lowercase everywhere.
test_credentials: Seeded credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (ChangeMe123!). Throwaway emails bf_<uuid>@royal11.com and otp_<uuid>@example.com used for brute-force/OTP tests to avoid locking seeded accounts.
seed_data_creation: None — used ephemeral throwaway users; login_attempts/security_alerts collections cleaned via module-scoped fixture in test_login_security.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP debug codes readable via grep 'OTP_DEBUG <email> -> ' in /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log. When testing SA console SecurityPanel with playwright, click nav-security WITHOUT force=True (the motion.span active indicator does not intercept clicks; force may miss the button). Wallet response shape is {wallet:{balance:int}, transactions:[]}, not flat 'balance'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
